messages:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm holding off on merging PR #14250. APAC deploy freeze starts in ~30m and CI is still flaky for mac matrix. Can we get quick eyes and a plan? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jonah: @Maya thanks for the ping. What's failing specifically on mac? link to logs? :eyes:

Maya: A flaky unit in tests/ui that times out intermittently — stacktrace points to snapshot ordering. Non-blocking on linux. Full CI link: https://ci.redwood/14250

CI-bot: build/14250: mac-matrix/job-3 FAILED — flaky-test: tests/ui/snapshot_test.py::test_ordering (timeout) — rerun suggested. https://ci.redwood/14250/mac-matrix

Priya: If we rerun the mac job will it unstick? Queue is a bit backlogged today. Infra shows a 25m median queue. :confused:

Infra-bot: current CI queue length: 42 jobs. ETA for mac runners: ~22-28 minutes. Priority lanes: canary and security scans.

Alex: Two options: 1) hold and wait for rerun slot, 2) manual canary deploy of the current main (if compatible) and land in a small window, 3) push a hotfix removing the flaky assert and land today. Which feels best?

Maya: Leaning to option 1 if rerun is quick. Option 3 feels risky. Option 2 needs approvals from infra and product for canary.

Jonah: I can try a targeted rerun for the mac matrix. If it flakes again we should consider toggling the flaky test behind an env var. Running: `/ci rerun 14250 --matrix=mac`

CI-bot: rerun requested by Jonah — queuing mac matrix. Position in queue: 38. Estimated start: 21m.

Sara: If it helps I can ssh into a mac runner and run the single test locally to reproduce. Happy to do that now. :thumbsup:

Maya: That would be great, @Sara. Repo: github.com/redwood/inference PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/14250 — test path: tests/ui/snapshot_test.py::test_ordering

Sara: grabbing a mac instance now. will post results in ~10m.

Priya: Quick note — we have an upcoming maintenance window at 2026-03-18T02:00Z where merges are blocked. If we can't get green before that, we should defer until after.

Maya: Thanks — timeline helps. If rerun finishes before maintenance, we'll aim to land. If not, we'll schedule for the next rebase window (Mon morning).

Jonah: Also, FYI, if the mac job fails again we can do a focused patch: wrap the flaky assertion with `if os.getenv('CI_ALLOW_FLAKY') != '1': assert ...` and document a follow-up ticket to remove the guard. Minimizes risk for today.

Maya: Noted. Let's wait for Sara + rerun. Will call it at T-10m to maintenance if still blocked. :clock10:

Infra-bot: maintenance window reminder: 2026-03-18T02:00Z (UTC). Merge freeze enforced at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z.

Sara: local run: reproduced timeout, looks like test hangs on `render_snapshot()` when run with parallel workers. Running single-threaded now…

Sara: single-threaded run passed. Suspect race in the test. I pushed a draft PR with a one-line test tweak invoking `pytest -k test_ordering -s -x -n 0` equivalent locally, but not yet committing to main branch.

Maya: Good find. Given maintenance timing, I'm going to hold merge for now and open a ticket to either revert or guard the test if it blocks next run. Linking ticket: https://issues.redwood/INFR-889

Jonah: Sounds good. If queue clears earlier we can re-evaluate. Thanks @Sara for reproducing. :pray:

Maya: Will update the PR description and ping again if the rerun passes before freeze. Otherwise moving to rebase window Monday. :shipit::eyes:
